headlines.text: Flash back to 2020, when there was a changing of the guard for the AEW World Tag Team Titles as The Young Bucks vs. FTR battled it out, appearing on Full Gear, rated 9.07 ? a stone-cold classic ? ending the champion's reign at 4 defenses. A love letter to tag team wrestling and a genuine all-timer ? this 29-minute war earned a rare five-plus-star rating and is still remembered as one of the best tag matches ever held in the U.S., finally handing the Bucks their first-ever AEW World Tag Team Titles.

On this day in 2020, a new champion was crowned for the AEW TNT Title as Darby Allin vs. Cody Rhodes battled it out, appearing on Full Gear, rated 7.91 ? a well-worked match ? ending the champion's reign at 6 defenses. Cody Rhodes was challenging for gold for the very first time. Allin's first-ever AEW title win, capping a memorable year-long rivalry ? a hard-hitting 4.25-star battle that saw the young star finally break through and claim the TNT Championship for himself.

On this day in 2020, Kenny Omega vs. Adam Page met in a Tournament Final, getting things started right out of the gate on Full Gear, rated 8.56 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype ? part of a stacked Full Gear 2020 card, rated 8.75 overall.
